user_goal: Correct the two v0.1.8 public-attestation failures and publish an exact, clean v0.1.9 patch.

baseline.protection_evidence: origin/main and v0.1.8 tag resolve to the exact reviewed release commit
baseline.selection_reason: Public attestation found a Linux test portability failure and an unignored generated owner record.

semantic_changes: Ignore the generated machine-local owner record.
Skip Windows-only listener ownership integration tests when Windows PowerShell tools are unavailable.
Publish and attest v0.1.9 without rewriting prior releases.
No ledger mutation, unrelated behavior change, foreign listener takeover, secret exposure, force push, tag rewrite, or release without exact review and attestation.

invariants: Windows continues to execute the real listener ownership tests.
Non-Windows CI skips only Windows-specific process-boundary tests.
A normal owned install leaves git status clean while retaining the owner record.
PR, CI, CodeRabbit, signed receipts, public main, tag, installed package, and live service bind one exact candidate.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Exact scope and both fixes pass local and cross-platform tests.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Broad skips or ignored runtime data.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: PR 3 has resolved CodeRabbit feedback and green exact-head CI.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Merge with unresolved or failed checks.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Signed receipts, verifier, guard, version, docs, and rollback approve exact v0.1.9.
Public Actions, tag, installed package, clean checkout, owner record, connector, and live service match.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Dirty install or failed public workflow.

proof_requirements.claim: Full local tests and explicit platform assertions prove narrow portability and ignore behavior.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: full suite, static checks, ignore proof

proof_requirements.claim: Raw PR reviews and exact-head checks are green.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: inspect all reviews, threads, comments, CI
proof_requirements.expected_observation: zero unresolved findings and all checks success

proof_requirements.claim: Independent review, signed chain, verifier, and guard approve the candidate.
Public and installed evidence are exact and clean.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Actions, tag, package, health, owner, connector, git status

release_requirements.required_receipt: signed chain accepted by verifier and guard

stop_conditions: Unexpected diff, dirty or multiple worktrees, broad skip, failed CI/review, non-PASS receipt, SHA mismatch, foreign listener risk, or rollback failure.
known_discrepancies: v0.1.8 is installed and healthy but its release-verifier workflow failed on Windows-only tests under Linux and its owner record is currently unignored.

requirement_trace.authority: User continuation of the reviewed release through clean public attestation
